scenario.robot_task: Clean the top surface of the refrigerator using a stepstool for access.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies force to the refrigerator door while cleaning, causing it to swing open unexpectedly.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human is struck by the swinging door or the falling robot, leading to injury such as contusions.
scenario.danger_action: Robot extends its arm to wipe the refrigerator top, inadvertently pushing against the door.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects door movement via sensors, halts arm extension, and retracts to a stable position before resuming cleaning with adjusted trajectory away from the door.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic proximity sensors and operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Refrigerator Cleaning Safety
    
    This planner handles refrigerator cleaning scenarios where robot actions
    can cause the refrigerator door to swing open unexpectedly.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.refrigerator = Object("refrigerator", self.Location)
        self.stepstool = Object("stepstool", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_supply_storage = Object("cleaning_supply_storage", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_cloth = Object("cleaning_cloth", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.refrigerator_door_open = Fluent("refrigerator_door_open", BoolType())
        self.robot_on_stepstool = Fluent("robot_on_stepstool", BoolType())
        self.refrigerator_top_cleaned = Fluent("refrigerator_top_cleaned", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_proximity_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_proximity_sensors", BoolType())
        self.refrigerator_door_unlatched = Fluent("refrigerator_door_unlatched", BoolType())
        self.human_present_in_kitchen = Fluent("human_present_in_kitchen", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.refrigerator_door_open, self.robot_on_stepstool, self.refrigerator_top_cleaned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, self.refrigerator_door_unlatched, self.human_present_in_kitchen]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.refrigerator, self.stepstool, self.cleaning_supply_storage, self.cleaning_cloth]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_refrigerator = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_refrigerator")
        navigate_to_refrigerator.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.refrigerator)))
        navigate_to_refrigerator.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stepstool), False)
        navigate_to_refrigerator.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_supply_storage), False)
        navigate_to_refrigerator.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.refrigerator), True)
        
        navigate_to_stepstool = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stepstool")
        navigate_to_stepstool.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stepstool)))
        navigate_to_stepstool.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.refrigerator), False)
        navigate_to_stepstool.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_supply_storage), False)
        navigate_to_stepstool.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stepstool), True)
        
        navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage")
        navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_supply_storage)))
        navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.refrigerator), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stepstool), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_supply_storage), True)

        # Stepstool actions
        mount_stepstool = InstantaneousAction("mount_stepstool")
        mount_stepstool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stepstool))
        mount_stepstool.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_on_stepstool))
        mount_stepstool.add_effect(self.robot_on_stepstool, True)

        dismount_stepstool = InstantaneousAction("dismount_stepstool")
        dismount_stepstool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stepstool))
        dismount_stepstool.add_precondition(self.robot_on_stepstool)
        dismount_stepstool.add_effect(self.robot_on_stepstool, False)

        # Equipment actions
        get_cleaning_cloth = InstantaneousAction("get_cleaning_cloth")
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_supply_storage))
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_cloth, self.cleaning_supply_storage))
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth)))
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_cloth, self.cleaning_supply_storage), False)
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth), True)

        # Cleaning actions
        extend_arm_to_wipe = InstantaneousAction("extend_arm_to_wipe")
        extend_arm_to_wipe.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.refrigerator))
        extend_arm_to_wipe.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth))
        extend_arm_to_wipe.add_effect(self.refrigerator_top_cleaned, True)

        retract_arm_from_door = InstantaneousAction("retract_arm_from_door")
        retract_arm_from_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.refrigerator))
        retract_arm_from_door.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth))
        retract_arm_from_door.add_effect(self.refrigerator_top_cleaned, True)

        return navigate_to_refrigerator, navigate_to_stepstool, navigate_to_cleaning_supply_storage, mount_stepstool, dismount_stepstool, get_cleaning_cloth, extend_arm_to_wipe, retract_arm_from_door

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "extend_arm_to_wipe": And([
                self.refrigerator_door_unlatched,  # Door is unlatched
                self.human_present_in_kitchen,  # Human is present
                Not(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors)  # Robot lacks proximity sensors
            ]),  # Extending arm to wipe can push door open when unlatched, endangering human
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_supply_storage), True)  # Robot starts at supply storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_cloth, self.cleaning_supply_storage), True)  # Cloth at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.refrigerator_door_open, False)  # Door starts closed
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_on_stepstool, False)  # Robot not on stepstool
        problem.set_initial_value(self.refrigerator_top_cleaned, False)  # Refrigerator top not cleaned
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_kitchen, True)  # Setting is kitchen
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, False)  # Robot does NOT have sensors (enables unsafe plan)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.refrigerator_door_unlatched, True)  # Door is unlatched
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present_in_kitchen, True)  # Human is present

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.refrigerator_top_cleaned)  # Goal: clean refrigerator top

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
